katie: @channel :loudspeaker: Quick update: were bringing a small MI300E edge micro-pool online in Milwaukee (MKE) for Dedicated customers. This is intended for low-latency regional pilots and internal testing. Please review the guidance below before reserving.

capacity-bot: Automated: pool provisioned -> mke-mi300e-edge-1 (3 nodes, 1 shard each). Tags: region=mke, pool_type=edge, gpu=mi300e.

raj: Thanks! What's the initial burst policy during the cold start?

katie: Burst window daily 09:00-11:00 CDT for the next 7 days to warm caches and capture perf traces. After 7 days we switch to 2h rotational burst aligned to fairshare.

mike: Ops note: avoid hard pinning to mke-mi300e-edge-1 for the first 48h. We may soft-fallback requests to nearby compatible pools if we need to rebalance.

ana: Reservation CLI example:
```
redwood reserve create --pool mke-mi300e-edge-1 --qty 2 --start 2026-04-18T09:00:00-05:00 --duration 4h --flex
```
Use `--flex` to mark burst reservations (non-guaranteed).

sanjay: Billing note: this pool uses the "edge/mi300e" rate tier. For committed needs contact capacity@redwood.ai to discuss short-term reserved buckets.

katie: Docs link: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/pools#mke-mi300e (pool id, SLOs, tagging). Quick checklist:
- tag workloads with region=mke for affinity
- avoid strict model-variant pinning for 72h
- enable telemetry flag `redwood.telemetry.edge_sampling=true` to help perf analysis

mike: Security/compliance: standard audit logging applies. No additional controls for this pool; private deployments remain customer-managed for KMS/HSM.

ana: Ops health check snippet:
```
# check pool status
redwood pool status mke-mi300e-edge-1
# sample output:
# state: ready
# nodes: 3
# active_reservations: 0
```

katie: TL;DR: small MI300E edge micro-pool in Milwaukee is live. Warm-up burst 09:00-11:00 CDT daily for 7 days. Follow reservation guidance and tag routes. Ping me or @mike for issues. :rocket: 

capacity-bot: Reminder scheduled: utilization summary will post tomorrow at 09:05 CDT for the warm-up window.
